div.div: عِذْيَوْطٌ (S, O, Msb, K) and عُذْيُوطٌ (Th, L, K) and ↓ عِذْوَطٌ (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K) Qui alvum ejicit, ventumve per anum emittit, in coïtu: (S, O, Msb, K:) or qui semen emittit ante congressum: (K:) or qui semen in coïtu non emittit: (TA:) and so with ة applied to a woman: (S, O, Msb:) pl. عِذْيَوْطُونَ [masc.] and عَذَايِيطُ and عَذَاوِيطُ; (Lth, O, K;) the last contr. to rule. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
